In the Southern Counties A.A.A. 6 miles championship at Portsmouth on April 28th, Bill Kerr finished an excellent 5th in 29:19.4, breaking Charlie Dabb's club record by 8.6 seconds. Winner was Batty (28:55.0) from Strong (28a58.4) and D.

Brian Morris finished 2nd to Nick Overhead (Watford) in Invitation 400 m. at White City on August Bank Holiday Monday with a time of 48.3. Gerry North finished behind Batty and Snowden in the rain-spoiled 5,000m,clocking 14:30.6.
Batty, Briault and Johnston lead from Craig, Strong, Turner and Fowler with Don Taylor and Montague partly hidden. Heatley (the winner) and Bullivant complete the leading group.

On a flooded, heavy track at Southampton on Sept.4th, and in a constant downpour, Bill Kerr finished off the track season with an excellent 13:57.4 three miles. He was 2nd to Batty (13:47.4) but beat the Portsmouth runners D.

Pat Newell was our only runner in the Rochester Road Race on Nov 16th, finishing 16th with 26:15 in a good class field. Batty was the winner, from Strong and Gibson. Bill Kerr was 2nd in the Faversham '5' on November 30th.
In the unofficial top-ten cross country rankings for 1964, Gerry North was ranked 6th behind Batty, Hill, Turner, Cooke and Heatley despite beating three of them in the International Championship.
